apis_and_anchors.meaning: Existing CLI selects heldout archives and calls fixed build_reporting_packets.
validate_input_bindings binds original exact source, approvals, receipts and heldout reconstruction; cannot authorize new dev inference unchanged.
_actual_maps reconstructs actual W from V and evaluator address replacements; keep evaluator truth outside source inference.
_full_candidates expands current then replaces only selected address.
_donor_evidence verifies named exact gates, donor/update inventory and archived timing.
_case_panels current source replaces previous address with selected_current[11]; next uses original selected_next[12] at world%4.
build_reporting_packets explicitly forbids source/head calls and fixes existing cases/inventory.
Read actual case queried role at decision12 and pass ROLES[role] explicitly.
export_packet supports equal previous/candidate addresses, matched source+W panels and separate native/field hashes.
compare_packets checks native and field identities plus restored content identity; retains null pairs.
_assemble starts W11, replaces previous node using source decoder, then replaces candidate for each symbol. Equal addresses produce true source_current and all alternatives at one item.
Learned update modifies only addressed hidden slot; predict(observation,state,candidate_address) accesses V and addressed h.
build_learned_sources shares architecture/fit coordinates but independently fitted A/ordinary checkpoints. ExactAlias is not independent.
snapshot_state, patch_addressed_state, restore_state clone storage and check source/type/time/update compatibility.
NativePredictionReadout consumes raw maps using frozen native head and native fit-only standardizer.
First12 commands cycle addresses0..3; previous at decision12 is3. Original candidate12 is world%4 and role is world%2.
donor_prefix changes chosen evaluator mapping and makes reachable history; permitted source feedback is commands0..10 only.
_observation supplies restricted V/W11/previous-command boundary; _visibility/_predict_logged preserve state/input hashes.
Current donor at time12 patches address3; _replay_donor uses exactly permitted feedback.
All-address decoder probes retain hashes/shapes, not raw maps/readout fields.
selected_next_maps/fields retain original candidate alternatives at each time; selected_current indexed time-1.
pre_reveal_hidden/survivors/revealed_symbols retain state for frozen reconstruction.
Existing donor patch/restoration checks: selected state transfer, nonselected isolation, exact restoration.
Frozen source loading recipe from fit normalizer/checkpoints; do not invoke full phase runner.
donor_reference/reached_reference independently reconstruct donor histories; fixed96-world assumptions require adaptation.
verify_production_replay demonstrates frozen source/head construction and exact archived output/state checks.
head_reference/fields_reference provide independent native H equations.

finding: Feasible as a distinct bounded source extension. The existing heldout exporter cannot supply missing dev same-address donor alternatives by relabeling.
inspection_scope: Code only. No archives, numeric outputs, source/head inference, fitting, API calls, Git/GitHub operations or report/rater outputs.
minimal_future_path: Bind separate dev archive, fit checkpoint and native-head identities, fixed twelve-case inventory and reviewed source closure before execution. Preserve original exporter/bindings.
Reconstruct recipient W11 and native W12 from V/address replacement and archived actual fields. Construct ObservationBatch(V,W11,12,11,CommandBatch(address[11],symbol[11]),all-observed).
Construct SourceState(pre_reveal_hidden[:,12].clone(),11,tuple(range(11)),source_key), or analytic masks/seen history analog. Load immutable fit normalizer/checkpoints; no fitting.

Predict with candidate_address=previous_command.address. Current at address3 is a source estimate; other current nodes are W11 copies. Native W reference uses W12 and all three archived V-derived operator-family alternatives at address3, assembled over W12.

Use current donor schedule at time12, snapshot recipient state, transfer only donor address3 hidden state (same source/encoder/V/history), predict with identical recipient observation and candidate; restore saved snapshot and predict again. W reference remains byte-identical.

Reuse exact archived current maps/fields selected_current[11] and current donor ledger selected_current[0]. Produce missing donor alternatives with frozen decoder then native H. Reuse H output only after exact matching raw input identity.

Export via SourcePanel/export_packet with actual query role; verify types/shapes/finite fields, current source origin, three symbols, recipient V/W11 invariance, nonselected state/map isolation, immutable weights and exact restored state/native maps/fields/content. Keep null changes.

new_inference.baseline_optimization: selected_next_maps/fields[:,11] already contain address3 alternatives. From decision11 to12 only feedback command10 at address2 updates state, so addressed h3 is unchanged. Reuse requires explicit exact state/address/raw-map/field checks and new decision12 provenance.
new_inference.world3_exception: Original candidate12==previous==3 for world3; existing baseline/current-donor alternatives already coincide.
new_inference.worlds0to2_limit: Donor current ledger has one current map at address3 plus three next maps at original candidate0..2. It lacks at least the other two address3 symbols. Probe hashes cannot recover maps or H fields. New bounded decoder/H inference is needed unless exact existing input identities can be proved.

reusable_checks_and_limits: Existing receipt/hash/source/registration/fitted/native identity patterns can be adapted for dev/new closure; original heldout binding is not authorization for this extension.
Existing W reconstruction, actual family exact reconstruction, state reachability and visibility receipts, prediction pre/post input/state hashes and immutable weights are useful.

Named restoration current/next/policy-fields/state and patch state-transfer/nonselected-state/current/next/decoder/inheritance gates can be reused for their recorded scope; old next gates concern old candidate and do not certify new arrays.
Current donor receipts require11 feedback events, command indices0..10, and source state through revealW11. W12/concealed donor W12 must never enter source state or observation.
Core patch validates source/type/history but cannot prove equal V or donor reachability; independent reconstruction/receipts must establish them.
Use current donor, not prospective donor at original world%4 for worlds0..2. Keep recipient V/W11 and native W unchanged; do not use donor W as recipient observation.
Existing experiment/verifier helpers assume96 worlds and full phase inventories. Do not invoke whole evaluate_sources, execute_phase, build_reporting_packets or reconstruction to obtain twelve cases.
Native H standardizer differs from source FitNormalizer. For analytic use H(posterior mean map), not posterior mean of H fields.

No archive values were inspected. No changed peak/map/choice/report is guaranteed; no filtering by effect. Changing packet candidate_node alone misdescribes old arrays. No new qualification follows from this code feasibility result.
